lsass-access: Sysmon | where EventID == 10 and TargetImage endswith "lsass.exe"
lsass-mask-in: Sysmon | where EventID == 10 and GrantedAccess in ("0x1fffff", "0x1010", "0x1410", "0x143a")
powershell-encoded: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "-EncodedCommand"
firewall-allow: CommonSecurityLog | where DeviceAction == "Allow" and DestinationPort in (22, 3389, 445)
ssh-bruteforce: Syslog | where ProcessName == "sshd" and SyslogMessage contains "Failed password"
ssh-bruteforce-threshold: Syslog | where ProcessName == "sshd" and SyslogMessage contains "Failed password" | summarize Attempts=count() by SrcIp=ExtractIP(SyslogMessage) | where Attempts >= 10
role-assigned: AuditLogs | where OperationName == "Add member to role"
mailbox-forward: OfficeActivity | where Operation in ("Set-Mailbox", "New-InboxRule") and Parameters contains "ForwardTo"
key-vault-access: AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceType == "VAULTS" and OperationName contains "secret"
vssadmin: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "delete"
bcdedit: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "recoveryenabled"
certutil: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "certutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "urlcache"
mshta: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "mshta.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "http"
regsvr32: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "regsvr32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "scrobj"
rundll32: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "javascript"
wmic: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "process call create"
net-user: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "/add"
sc-create: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "create"
ntlm-logon: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 3 and AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM"
noisy-cmd: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | summarize c=count() by Image | where c > 100
